title: Theoretical mass ratios from the mass identity
html:
Remark. Theoretical mass ratios from the mass identity

The mass identity expresses inertial mass as the norm of a nonabelian multiplicative integral over a surface bounding the vortex filament. In the Descartes universe (\chi(\mathcal{S}) = -6), bundle topology constrains vortex configurations and determines the mass spectrum. Evaluating the mass identity at successive levels of the brane tower (recursive brane tower) yields mass ratio predictions.
